_comment: Copy this to local.settings.json (gitignored) and adjust the absolute paths. PYTHONPATH MUST include both the repo root AND .funcvenv/Lib/site-packages — the Functions worker needs the latter to import azure.durable_functions / azure.identity / agent_framework etc. Without it, cold start hits ModuleNotFoundError. local.settings.json Values WIN over env vars set in the parent shell, so this is the only reliable place to pin PYTHONPATH.
